relevance_note: Single-patient case report of arterial tortuosity syndrome diagnosed on imaging without genetic testing ("Genetic confirmation was not done."); in scope by diagnosis, but no SLC2A10 variant is reported.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; output assembled with a short Python script from hand-chosen spans, every span checked verbatim. In scope: the case patient (clinical/radiological ATS diagnosis, no genetic testing, so no variant rows) and the Ertugrul 1967 patient described in the Discussion (ref [12]; sex, age and arterial features given). Age 41 recorded as age at last evaluation (age at presentation; follow-up one month later); no age at onset or diagnosis stated. Systemic hypertension excluded from 'There was no history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension', although she was later given antihypertensive medication 'aimed at vascular risk optimization and reduction of hemodynamic stress' (not stated as treating hypertension). Aortic root aneurysm excluded from the general CTA statement 'No aneurysm, dissection, or intramural hematoma was identified.'; the root is not named specifically. Left main coronary stenosis (40-45%) not mapped to the checklist item 'stenosis of the aorta or aortic branches' (left not reported); exertional dyspnea not mapped to 'respiratory distress or insufficiency'. Normal routine laboratory investigations (CBC, renal/liver/thyroid function, urine, serology) recorded as excluded abnormalities named by the paper; nothing more specific inferred. 'No family history of connective tissue disorders' concerns relatives, not recorded as a feature. No variants, n_patients_reported null (no SLC2A10 variant described). No contradictions found.
